notes.title: The first playtest was held!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! I'm glad to announce that we've conducted our first closed playtest. It was held in a limited format, so not everyone had access. We've collected feedback and heard your suggestions. We're currently working on bug fixes and preparing for a second, larger test. It's scheduled to take place in 2-3 weeks.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who participated and provided feedback.[/p]
